versions.subject: Fix all the rules to pass the test
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i).*bitsadmin.*/SetNotifyCmdLine.*(%COMSPEC%|cmd.exe|regsvr32.exe).*'
selection_2:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i).*bitsadmin.*/Addfile.*(http|https|ftp|ftps):.*'
condition: selection_1 or selection_2
versions.spl: | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch>(?i).*bitsadmin.*/SetNotifyCmdLine.*(%COMSPEC%|cmd.exe|regsvr32.exe).*)" | eval CommandLineCondition=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch), "true", "false") | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch2>(?i).*bitsadmin.*/Addfile.*(http|https|ftp|ftps):.*)" | eval CommandLineCondition2=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch2), "true", "false") | search CommandLineCondition="true" OR CommandLineCondition2="true"

versions.subject: Refactor regex
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'bitsadmin'
        - '/SetNotifyCmdLine'
    CommandLine|contains:  
        - '%COMSPEC%'
        - 'cmd.exe'
        - 'regsvr32.exe'
selection_2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'bitsadmin'
        - '/Addfile'
    CommandLine|contains:    
        - 'http:'
        - 'https:'
        - 'ftp:'
        - 'ftps:'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*bitsadmin*" CommandLine="*/SetNotifyCmdLine*" CommandLine IN ("*%COMSPEC%*", "*cmd.exe*", "*regsvr32.exe*")) OR (CommandLine="*bitsadmin*" CommandLine="*/Addfile*" CommandLine IN ("*http:*", "*https:*", "*ftp:*", "*ftps:*"))
